data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2021 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 15.424m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows favourable development in prior underwriting years (primarily the 2019 underwriting year), producing an aggregate prior-year release of approximately GBP 2.0m. No explicit narrative quantifying a gross prior-year movement was provided; the amount is derived from the gross claims development table.
raw_causal_phrases: case by case review and judgement
data.data_quality_notes: No explicit sentence stating a GROSS prior-year reserve movement was found. Prior-year movement computed from the gross claims development table (triangle) on page 31 by excluding the two most recent underwriting years (2021 and 2020) and comparing the 2019 current estimate to its prior diagonal. The triangle and notes are presented in GBP '000; values converted to millions. The Statement of Financial Position and Note 4 contain overall changes in claims outstanding but these include current year movements; therefore the triangle was used to isolate prior-year development. Confidence is moderate due to limited historical columns (only 2019 as prior-year) and lack of an explicit gross prior-year movement narrative.
